_comment: Per-file budget of DIRECT (non-DX8Wrapper) IDirect3DDevice8 / IDirect3D8 call sites,
enforced by scripts/ci/check-d3d8-surface.py in the native-port CI workflow.
The check is exact: more sites than budgeted fails (the wrapper was bypassed), fewer also
fails (the budget is stale and must be tightened in the PR that earned it).
_state: 4 sites across 1 file. PR #8 ('Consolidate all Direct3D 8 access behind DX8Wrapper') has
merged, taking the surface from 376 direct sites across 19 files to none, so the budget is
an exact gate rather than a ratchet: any unbudgeted call site anywhere fails the build.
The 4 are all in d3dx8texcreate.cpp, the off-Windows replacement for d3dx8.lib rather than
Every D3D8 call in the engine goes through the DX8Wrapper chokepoint, which is what makes
swapping the backend tractable; this file is what keeps it that way.
_pr8_documented_exceptions: PR #8's four documented exceptions. None of them is a 'direct' site by the scanner's
definition, which is why the budget is 0 rather than 4:
1. dx8wrapper.{h,cpp}'s own ~61 sites - the chokepoint itself, all expressed as DX8CALL*
macros, so they are counted as wrapper sites, not direct ones.
2. 23 `DX8Wrapper::_Get_D3D_Device8()` null tests - no interface method is invoked, so the
3. dx8webbrowser.cpp:95 hands the raw device pointer to a closed COM control - a pointer
4. D3DX* entry points - a separate library, not IDirect3DDevice8; out of the scanner's scope.

Core/Libraries/Source/WWVegas/WW3D2/d3dx.reason: d3dx8.lib's creation entry points off Windows, not engine call sites: D3DXCreateTexture/CubeTexture/VolumeTexture each end in the matching IDirect3DDevice8::Create* call on the device their CALLER passes in, plus the GetDeviceCaps that decides the size, mip count and format to create -- and that caller is DX8Wrapper, so routing them back through DX8CALL would be circular. PR #8's documented exception 4 covers the calls INTO this library; these 4 are the ones it makes back out. When the caller passes no device (every call behind a non-D3D8 backend) none of these 4 sites runs at all: the helpers dispatch through RenderBackendClass instead. The count is exact, so a fifth fails.
